ZeroAds changes which DNS resolver iOS uses, and adds a rule list for Safari.
That is all it does.

Pick a filter list and ZeroAds points your iPhone at the public encrypted-DNS
resolver that publishes it. That operator declines to resolve advertising and
tracking domains, so those domains never load — in apps and in Safari, not just
in the browser. Filtering happens on the operator's servers, using their own
published list.

AD BLOCKING IN SAFARI

ZeroAds includes a Safari content blocker: a rule list Safari compiles and
enforces itself. It is free and does not need Pro. Switch it on under
Settings › Apps › Safari › Extensions › ZeroAds.

It covers what a DNS resolver cannot reach:

• Ad slots left behind in the page, so a blocked ad leaves no gap.
• Cookie-consent pop-ups — OneTrust, Cookiebot, CookieYes, Quantcast, TrustArc
  and others. These are part of the site's own HTML, so no DNS filter can
  touch them.
• Ad and tracker requests matched by path, not only by domain.

All 93 rules are hand-written for this app.

FOUR FILTER LISTS — ONE FREE, THREE WITH PRO

• Cloudflare Filtered — Cloudflare 1.1.1.2. Free. Cloudflare's own
  flagged-domain list. Advertising domains are not on it, so ads still load.
• Ads & Trackers — AdGuard DNS Default. Requires Pro. Declines to resolve
  advertising and tracking domains.
• Quad9 Filtered — Quad9 9.9.9.9. Requires Pro. A non-profit resolver applying
  its published block list. Advertising domains are not on it, so ads still
  load.
• Family — AdGuard Family. Requires Pro. Advertising and tracking domains plus
  adult-content domains.

Switch lists whenever you like. Changing list is instant, and so is turning
filtering on and off.

NO VPN

ZeroAds does not use a VPN or a packet tunnel. There is no VPN icon in your
status bar, nothing runs in the background, and there is no battery cost from
a tunnel. iOS sends DNS queries straight to the resolver you chose.

WHAT ZEROADS DOES NOT DO

• It does not block ads inside YouTube. YouTube serves video ads from the same
  hostnames as the video itself, so no DNS-based blocker can separate the two —
  blocking those hosts would stop playback. The same applies to any app serving
  ads from its own domains.
• It does not scan your device, check it for viruses or malware, or look for
  security or privacy problems.
• It does not inspect your traffic.
• It runs no server of its own and never receives your DNS queries.
• It shows no count of what was blocked. iOS gives the app no visibility into
  what the resolver did, so any number here would be invented.

HOW iOS HANDLES THIS

iOS keeps the choice of DNS resolver with you. When you turn the filter on, iOS
may ask you to allow it — tap Allow and you are done. If it does not ask, the
choice lives in Settings and ZeroAds walks you there. You can switch back to
Automatic at any time under Settings › General › VPN, DNS & Device Management.

Filter lists are operated by AdGuard, Cloudflare and Quad9. Each operator's
privacy policy is linked inside the app.

———

ZeroAds Pro unlocks the AdGuard DNS Default, Quad9 and AdGuard Family lists.
Cloudflare Filtered and the Safari rule list stay free. If you installed
ZeroAds before this version, all four lists remain available on your install.

Lifetime purchase. The yearly plan includes a 3-day free trial; any unused
portion of that trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription. Payment is

AdBlock Max is a Safari ad blocker built around two core features: blocking ads across the web and blocking YouTube ads on youtube.com in Safari. It also reduces pop-ups, trackers, cookie prompts, and other page clutter, so browsing feels cleaner and more private.
BLOCK ADS IN SAFARI
• Block banner ads, pop-ups, overlays, and other intrusive advertising.
• Filter unwanted page elements before they interrupt your browsing.
• Pause blocking anytime or allow websites you trust.
BLOCK YOUTUBE ADS IN SAFARI
• Block ads when watching YouTube on youtube.com in Safari.
• Reduce interruptions while watching videos on iPhone or iPad.
• YouTube support applies to the website in Safari, not the official YouTube app.
• YouTube ad blocking requires Premium.
PRIVACY & TRACKER PROTECTION
• Block known trackers and unwanted tracking requests.
• Hide cookie prompts and other common web annoyances.
• AdBlock Max does not collect your browsing history.
• Blocking is handled on your device using Safari technologies.
MORE PROTECTION & CONTROL
• AI Smart Blocking helps detect ad elements that standard filters may miss.
• AI Threat Detection adds protection against suspicious pages.
• One-Tap Page Cleanup removes distracting page elements.
• Block adult websites and customize additional filter controls.
• Disable images or scripts when you want more control over a page.
PREMIUM & LIMITATIONS
• Advanced protection features, including YouTube ad blocking, require Premium.
• Because websites and Safari can change, some ads may occasionally still appear.

Brave is a fast, private web browser that blocks ads and trackers on every site, automatically. No settings to change, no extensions to install.

Over 125 million people browse with Brave. It's free, open source, and independent — we don't sell your browsing data.

Everything below is built into the browser. One app, not a stack of them.

BLOCK ADS ON EVERY SITE
Brave Shields stops banner ads, pop-ups, autoplay interruptions, and the ads that play before and during videos. Same on news sites, shopping sites, forums and video pages — no per-site setup, no ad blocker extension. It dismisses cookie consent banners too, and it's on from your first tab.

PRIVATE BROWSING THAT BLOCKS TRACKERS
Private mode in most browsers only hides your history from your own phone. Brave blocks the cross-site trackers and fingerprinting scripts that follow you from a shopping page to your social feed, strips tracking codes from links you copy, and turns on Global Privacy Control by default.

SHRED: DELETE ONE SITE'S DATA, NOT ALL OF IT
Clearing browser data usually logs you out of everything. Shred deletes the cookies and storage for one site and leaves your other sessions intact. Set Auto Shred to run whenever you close a tab.

BRAVE SEARCH: A PRIVATE SEARCH ENGINE, BUILT IN
Brave Search is the default search engine in the browser, running on its own independent index — not resold results from Google or Bing. It doesn't profile you or log your searches. Ask Brave puts search results and AI answers in one place. Switch search engines any time.

BRAVE LEO: A FREE AI ASSISTANT
Summarize a long article, translate a page, or draft a reply without leaving the tab. Choose from several AI models. Leo doesn't record your conversations, share them, or use them to train models.

BRAVE NEWS: A FEED WITH NO PROFILE BEHIND IT
Personalize a news feed from hundreds of sources or any RSS feed with Brave News.

FASTER PAGES, LESS MOBILE DATA
Ads and trackers are most of what a modern page downloads. Blocking them means fewer requests, less data and less battery drain. We rebuilt Brave's ad blocking engine to use 75% less memory, so it stays responsive with many tabs open.

MAKE BRAVE YOUR DEFAULT BROWSER
Open Settings, scroll to Brave, choose Default Browser App. Every link you tap — from Mail, Messages or any app — opens with ad and tracker blocking already on.

WHAT'S FREE AND WHAT ISN'T
Free: the browser, ad and tracker blocking, Shred, Brave Search, Brave Leo, Brave News, Sync and night mode.

Subscriptions: 
- Brave Firewall + VPN encrypts your whole device, not just browser traffic, with a kill switch and smart proxy. 
- Brave Leo Premium unlocks more capable AI models. 
- Brave Origin: The streamlined, minimalist browser that gives you Brave's industry-leading privacy and ad-blocking, with none of the extras.
One-time purchase: Brave Origin, an ultra-minimalist build of Brave — no AI, no crypto, nothing but the web. One purchase covers all your devices.

Also inside: encrypted Sync, a self-custody Brave Wallet (off by default), night mode, voice search, password autofill, custom app icons, and bookmark import from Safari or Chrome.

OPEN SOURCE
Brave is open source, so anyone can audit what the browser does. Read what we collect at https://brave.com/privacy/

Our mission is to protect your privacy online by building a fast, private browser — while growing a fairer revenue model for creators.
